Schedule a 60-minute meeting for the whole team (everyone returned by list_users) during the week of 2026-06-15 to 2026-06-19. Constraints: the slot must lie entirely within working hours 09:00-17:00 UTC, must start on a 30-minute boundary, and every team member must be free for the full hour. local users = tool('list_users', {})
local user_ids = {}
for _, u in ipairs(users) do
  user_ids[#user_ids + 1] = u.id
end

local dates = {'2026-06-15', '2026-06-16', '2026-06-17', '2026-06-18', '2026-06-19'}

-- For each user/date, get busy intervals
local busy_by_user_date = {}
for _, uid in ipairs(user_ids) do
  busy_by_user_date[uid] = {}
  for _, d in ipairs(dates) do
    local avail = tool('get_availability', {user_id = uid, date = d})
    busy_by_user_date[uid][d] = avail.busy or {}
  end
end

-- Helper: parse HH:MM to minutes since midnight
local function to_mins(t)
  local h, m = t:match('^(%d+):(%d+)$')
  return tonumber(h) * 60 + tonumber(m)
end

local function from_mins(m)
  return string.format('%02d:%02d', math.floor(m / 60), m % 60)
end

-- Working hours: 09:00-17:00, 60-min meeting, start on 30-min boundary
-- Possible starts: 09:00, 09:30, 10:00, ..., 16:00
local possible_starts = {}
for m = 9*60, 16*60, 30 do
  possible_starts[#possible_starts + 1] = m
end

local function is_free(busy_list, start_m, end_m)
  for _, b in ipairs(busy_list) do
    local bs = to_mins(b.start or '00:00')
    local be = to_mins(b['end'] or '24:00')
    -- overlap if start_m < be and end_m > bs
    if start_m < be and end_m > bs then
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end

-- Find earliest slot
for _, d in ipairs(dates) do
  for _, start_m in ipairs(possible_starts) do
    local end_m = start_m + 60
    local all_free = true
    for _, uid in ipairs(user_ids) do
      if not is_free(busy_by_user_date[uid][d], start_m, end_m) then
        all_free = false
        break
      end
    end
    if all_free then
      local start_s = d .. 'T' .. from_mins(start_m) .. ':00Z'
      local end_s = d .. 'T' .. from_mins(end_m) .. ':00Z'
      return {
        answer = {start = start_s, ['end'] = end_s},
        users = user_ids,
        num_users = #user_ids
      }
    end
  end
end

return {error = 'no slot found', users = user_ids}
